sentences.text: Christian Klein, born in 1980 and a German national, is chief executive officer and chairman of the Executive Board of SAP SE, holding overall responsibility for the company's strategic direction, management and performance.

sentences.quote: Klein (45) started his career at SAP in 1999 as a student. After holding various positions across the company, including Chief Financial Officer of SAP SuccessFactors and SAP's Chief Controlling Officer, he was appointed Chief Operating Officer of SAP in 2016, a role in which he continued until 2021.
sentences.text: He started at SAP in 1999 as a student and held various roles, including chief financial officer of SAP SuccessFactors and SAP's chief controlling officer, before being appointed chief operating officer in 2016, a role he held until 2021.

He joined the SAP Executive Board in 2018 as head of the Intelligent Enterprise Group, combining responsibility for core applications development and delivery with a cross-board mandate for global business operations.
Named co-CEO alongside Jennifer Morgan on October 11, 2019, he became sole CEO on April 20, 2020.

sentences.quote: Initially set for three years starting in May 2025, the contract has now been extended to five years, continuing until April 2030.
sentences.text: In May 2025 the Supervisory Board extended his contract to April 2030.

sentences.quote: Klein will transfer his oversight of the sales department to Thomas Saueressig, a board member who currently in charge of after-sales matters and helping clients deploy SAP's software
sentences.text: In March 2026 Christian Klein reorganized SAP's Executive Board around artificial intelligence, transferring his oversight of the sales organization to Thomas Saueressig, who became Chief Customer Officer from April 1, 2026.

sentences.quote: Part of this operational transfer includes the creation of a new board area for the Business AI Platform and CTO which will be led by SAP Extended Board member Philipp Herzig.
sentences.text: Product and engineering head Muhammad Alam said he would not renew his contract in 2027 for personal reasons and will stay on the Executive Board through his term while advising on AI strategy, with some operational duties moved earlier, including a new Business AI Platform and CTO board area led by Philipp Herzig from July 1, 2026.

sentences.quote: We delivered another quarter of strong current cloud backlog growth, up 26% at constant currencies. This performance is underpinned by our Autonomous Enterprise strategy
sentences.text: At Sapphire in May 2026 Klein launched the SAP Business AI Platform, tied to his "Autonomous Enterprise" vision, which he credited in Q2 2026 for 26% constant-currency current cloud backlog growth.

mgmt_recent.text: In March 2026 Christian Klein reorganized SAP's Executive Board around artificial intelligence, transferring his oversight of the sales organization to Thomas Saueressig, who became Chief Customer Officer from April 1, 2026. Product and engineering head Muhammad Alam said he would not renew his contract in 2027 for personal reasons and will stay on the Executive Board through his term while advising on AI strategy, with some operational duties moved earlier, including a new Business AI Platform and CTO board area led by Philipp Herzig from July 1, 2026. At Sapphire in May 2026 Klein launched the SAP Business AI Platform, tied to his "Autonomous Enterprise" vision, which he credited in Q2 2026 for 26% constant-currency current cloud backlog growth.
